The '''Circumtore system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|system]] in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] home to the [[Shell Hutts]] clan. Only [[Circumtore/Legends|one planet]] held life. The other [[Planet/Legends|planets]] in the system were blasted and lifeless, scarred by an ancient [[Disaster in the Circumtore system|cataclysm]].
